text_en: Meanwhile, when the crowd gathered by the thousands, so that they trampled on one another, he began to speak first to his disciples, “Beware of the yeast of the Pharisees, that is, their hypocrisy.
text_cn: 那时，有成千累万的群众集合拢来，竟至互相践踏。耶稣开始先对自己的门徒说：“你们要谨防法利塞人的酵母，即他们的虚伪。

text_en: Nothing is covered up that will not be uncovered, and nothing secret that will not become known.
text_cn: 但是，没有遮掩的事，将来不被揭露的；也没有隐藏的事，将来不被知道的。

text_en: Therefore whatever you have said in the dark will be heard in the light, and what you have whispered behind closed doors will be proclaimed from the housetops.
text_cn: 因此，你们在暗处所说的，将来必要在明处被人听见；在内室附耳所说的，将来必要在屋顶上张扬出来。

text_en: “I tell you, my friends, do not fear those who kill the body, and after that can do nothing more.
text_cn: 我告诉你们做我朋友的人们：你们不要害怕那些杀害肉身，而后不能更有所为的人。

text_en: But I will warn you whom to fear: fear him who, after he has killed, has authority to cast into hell. Yes, I tell you, fear him!
text_cn: 我要指给你们，谁是你们所应怕的：你们应当害怕杀了以后，有权柄把人投入地狱的那一位；的确，我告诉你们：应当害怕这一位！

text_en: Are not five sparrows sold for two pennies? Yet not one of them is forgotten in God’s sight.
text_cn: 五只麻雀不是卖两文铜钱吗？然而在天主前，他们中没有一只被遗忘的。

text_en: But even the hairs of your head are all counted. Do not be afraid; you are of more value than many sparrows.
text_cn: 就是你们的头发，也一一被数过了；你们不要害怕！你们比许多麻雀尊贵多了。

text_en: “And I tell you, everyone who acknowledges me before others, the Son of Man also will acknowledge before the angels of God;
text_cn: 我告诉你们：凡在人前承认我的，人子将来也要在天主的使者前承认他；

text_en: but whoever denies me before others will be denied before the angels of God.
text_cn: 在人前否认我的，将来在天主的使者前也要被否认。

text_en: And everyone who speaks a word against the Son of Man will be forgiven; but whoever blasphemes against the Holy Spirit will not be forgiven.
text_cn: 凡出言干犯人子的，尚可获得赦免；但是，亵渎圣神的人，决不能获得赦免。

text_en: When they bring you before the synagogues, the rulers, and the authorities, do not worry about how you are to defend yourselves or what you are to say;
text_cn: 当人押送你们到会堂，到官长及有权柄的人面前时，你们不要思虑怎样申辩，或说什么话，

text_en: for the Holy Spirit will teach you at that very hour what you ought to say. ”
text_cn: 因为在那个时刻，圣神必要教给你们应说的话。”

text_en: Someone in the crowd said to him, “Teacher, tell my brother to divide the family inheritance with me. ”
text_cn: 人群中有一个人向耶稣说：“师傅，请吩咐我的兄弟与我分家罢！”

text_en: But he said to him, “Friend, who set me to be a judge or arbitrator over you? ”
text_cn: 耶稣对他说：“人哪，谁立了我做你们的判官及分家人呢？”

text_en: And he said to them, “Take care! Be on your guard against all kinds of greed; for one’s life does not consist in the abundance of possessions. ”
text_cn: 遂对他们说：“你们要谨慎，躲避一切贪婪，因为一个人纵然富裕，他的生命并不在于他的资产。”

text_en: Then he told them a parable: “The land of a rich man produced abundantly.
text_cn: 耶稣对他们设了一个比喻说：“有一个富人，他的田地出产丰富。

text_en: And he thought to himself, ‘What should I do, for I have no place to store my crops? ’
text_cn: 他心里想道：我可怎么办呢？因为我已没有地方收藏我的物产。

text_en: Then he said, ‘I will do this: I will pull down my barns and build larger ones, and there I will store all my grain and my goods.
text_cn: 他遂说：我要这样做：我要拆毁我的仓房，另建更大的，好在那里收藏我的一切谷类及财物。

text_en: And I will say to my soul, Soul, you have ample goods laid up for many years; relax, eat, drink, be merry. ’
text_cn: 以后，我要对我的灵魂说：灵魂哪！你存有大量的财物，足够多年之用，你休息罢！吃喝宴乐罢！

text_en: But God said to him, ‘You fool! This very night your life is being demanded of you. And the things you have prepared, whose will they be? ’
text_cn: 天主却给他说：糊涂人哪！今夜就要索回你的灵魂，你所备置的，将归谁呢？

text_en: So it is with those who store up treasures for themselves but are not rich toward God. ”
text_cn: 那为自己厚积财产而不在天主前致富的，也是如此。”

text_en: He said to his disciples, “Therefore I tell you, do not worry about your life, what you will eat, or about your body, what you will wear.
text_cn: 耶稣对他的门徒说：“为此，我告诉你们：不要为生命思虑吃什么，也不要为身体思虑穿什么，

text_en: For life is more than food, and the body more than clothing.
text_cn: 因为生命贵于食物，身体贵于衣服。

text_en: Consider the ravens: they neither sow nor reap, they have neither storehouse nor barn, and yet God feeds them. Of how much more value are you than the birds!
text_cn: 你们看看乌鸦，它们不播种，也不收割；它们没有库房，也没有仓廪，天主尚且养活它们，你们比起飞鸟更要尊贵多少呢？

text_en: And can any of you by worrying add a single hour to your span of life?
text_cn: 你们中谁能运用思虑，使自己的寿数增加一肘呢？

text_en: If then you are not able to do so small a thing as that, why do you worry about the rest?
text_cn: 如果你们连极小的事还做不来，为什么要思虑别的事呢？

text_en: Consider the lilies, how they grow: they neither toil nor spin; yet I tell you, even Solomon in all his glory was not clothed like one of these.
text_cn: 你们看看百合花，是怎样生长的：它们不劳作，也不纺织；可是，我告诉你们：连撒罗满在他极盛的荣华时所披戴的，也不如这些花中的一朵。

text_en: But if God so clothes the grass of the field, which is alive today and tomorrow is thrown into the oven, how much more will he clothe you—you of little faith!
text_cn: 田野间的野草，今天还在，明天就投入炉中，天主尚且这样装饰，何况你们呢！小信德的人啊！

text_en: And do not keep striving for what you are to eat and what you are to drink, and do not keep worrying.
text_cn: 你们不要谋求吃什么，喝什么，也不要忧愁挂心，

text_en: For it is the nations of the world that strive after all these things, and your Father knows that you need them.
text_cn: 因为这一切都是世上的外邦人所寻求的，至于你们，你们的父知道你们需要这些。

text_en: Instead, strive for his kingdom, and these things will be given to you as well.
text_cn: 你们只要寻求他的国，这些自会加给你们。”

text_en: “Do not be afraid, little flock, for it is your Father’s good pleasure to give you the kingdom.
text_cn: “你们小小的羊群，不要害怕！因为你们的父喜欢把天国赐给你们。

text_en: Sell your possessions, and give alms. Make purses for yourselves that do not wear out, an unfailing treasure in heaven, where no thief comes near and no moth destroys.
text_cn: 要变卖你们所有的来施舍，为你们自己备下经久不朽的钱囊，在天上备下取用不尽的宝藏；那里盗贼不能走近，蠹(dù)虫也不能损坏，

text_en: For where your treasure is, there your heart will be also.
text_cn: 因为你们的宝藏在那里，你们的心也必在那里。”

text_en: “Be dressed for action and have your lamps lit;
text_cn: “要把你们的腰束起，把灯点着；

text_en: be like those who are waiting for their master to return from the wedding banquet, so that they may open the door for him as soon as he comes and knocks.
text_cn: 应当如同那些等候自己的主人，由婚筵回来的人，为的是主人来到，一敲门，立刻就给他开门。

text_en: Blessed are those slaves whom the master finds alert when he comes; truly I tell you, he will fasten his belt and have them sit down to eat, and he will come and serve them.
text_cn: 主人来到时，遇见醒寤着的那些仆人，是有福的。我实在告诉你们：主人要束上腰，请他们坐席，自己前来伺候他们。

text_en: If he comes during the middle of the night, or near dawn, and finds them so, blessed are those slaves.
text_cn: 他二更来也罢，三更来也罢，若遇见这样，那些人才是有福的。

text_en: “But know this: if the owner of the house had known at what hour the thief was coming, he would not have let his house be broken into.
text_cn: 你们应该明白这一点：如果家主知道盗贼何时要来，【他必要醒寤，】决不容自己的房屋被挖穿。

text_en: You also must be ready, for the Son of Man is coming at an unexpected hour. ”
text_cn: 你们也应当准备，因为在你们不料想的时辰，人子就来了。”

text_en: Peter said, “Lord, are you telling this parable for us or for everyone? ”
text_cn: 伯多禄说：“主，你讲的这个比喻，是为我们呢，还是为众人？”

text_en: And the Lord said, “Who then is the faithful and prudent manager whom his master will put in charge of his slaves, to give them their allowance of food at the proper time?
text_cn: 主说：“究竟谁是那忠信及精明的管家，主人派他管理自己的家仆，按时配给食粮？

text_en: Blessed is that slave whom his master will find at work when he arrives.
text_cn: 主人来时，看见他如此行事，那仆人才是有福的。

text_en: Truly I tell you, he will put that one in charge of all his possessions.
text_cn: 我实话告诉你们：主人必要委派他，管理自己的一切财产。

text_en: But if that slave says to himself, ‘My master is delayed in coming, ’ and if he begins to beat the other slaves, men and women, and to eat and drink and get drunk,
text_cn: 如果那个仆人心里说：我主人必然迟来；他便开始拷打仆婢，也吃也喝也醉酒。

text_en: the master of that slave will come on a day when he does not expect him and at an hour that he does not know, and will cut him in pieces, and put him with the unfaithful.
text_cn: 在他不期待的日子，不知觉的时刻，那仆人的主人要来，必要铲除他，使他与不信者遭受同样的命运。

text_en: That slave who knew what his master wanted, but did not prepare himself or do what was wanted, will receive a severe beating.
text_cn: 那知道主人的旨意，而偏不准备，或竟不奉行他旨意的仆人，必然要多受拷打；

text_en: But the one who did not know and did what deserved a beating will receive a light beating. From everyone to whom much has been given, much will be required; and from the one to whom much has been entrusted, even more will be demanded.
text_cn: 那不知道而做了应受拷打之事的，要少受拷打。给谁的多，向谁要的也多；交托谁的多，向谁索取的也格外多。”

text_en: “I came to bring fire to the earth, and how I wish it were already kindled!
text_cn: “我来是为把火投在地上，我是多么切望它已经燃烧起来！

text_en: I have a baptism with which to be baptized, and what stress I am under until it is completed!
text_cn: 我有一种应受的洗礼，我是如何焦急，直到它得以完成！

text_en: Do you think that I have come to bring peace to the earth? No, I tell you, but rather division!
text_cn: 你们以为我来是给地上送和平吗？不，我告诉你们：而是来送分裂。

text_en: From now on five in one household will be divided, three against two and two against three;
text_cn: 因为从今以后，一家五口的，将要分裂：三个反对两个，两个反对三个。

text_en: they will be divided: father against son and son against father, mother against daughter and daughter against mother, mother-in-law against her daughter-in-law and daughter-in-law against mother-in-law. ”
text_cn: 他们将要分裂：父亲反对儿子，儿子反对父亲；母亲反对女儿，女儿反对母亲；婆母反对儿媳，儿媳反对婆母。”

text_en: He also said to the crowds, “When you see a cloud rising in the west, you immediately say, ‘It is going to rain’; and so it happens.
text_cn: 耶稣又向群众说：“几时你们看见云彩由西方升起，立刻就说：要下大雨了；果然是这样。

text_en: And when you see the south wind blowing, you say, ‘There will be scorching heat’; and it happens.
text_cn: 几时南风吹来，就说：天要热了；果然是这样。

text_en: You hypocrites! You know how to interpret the appearance of earth and sky, but why do you not know how to interpret the present time?
text_cn: 假善人哪！你们知道观察地上及天上的气象，怎么不能观察这个时机呢？

text_en: “And why do you not judge for yourselves what is right?
text_cn: 你们为什么不能由自己来辨别正义的事呢？

text_en: Thus, when you go with your accuser before a magistrate, on the way make an effort to settle the case, or you may be dragged before the judge, and the judge hand you over to the officer, and the officer throw you in prison.
text_cn: 当你同你的对头去见官长时，尚在路上，你得设法与他了结，怕他拉你到法官前，法官把你交给刑役，而刑役把你押在狱中。

text_en: I tell you, you will never get out until you have paid the very last penny. ”
text_cn: 我告诉你：非等你还清最后的一分钱，断不能从那里出来。”
